 Quick Details
 Experience the ultimate winter fishing adventure in our cozy ice shack! Perfectly designed for groups of up to four, this charming wooden retreat offers a warm, inviting space to escape the chill while you reel in your catch.

Equipped with a wood heater, you’ll stay toasty as you enjoy the serene beauty of Door County’s frozen lakes. The shack features comfortable seating, ample fishing holes, and a scenic view of the snowy landscape. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or a first-time fisher, this is the ideal spot to create lasting memories with friends or family.

Book your ice shack rental today and make the most of Wisconsin’s winter fishing season!
